label: STOPP L5: gabapentinoid for non-neuropathic pain
title: Gabapentinoid for pain that is not nerve pain
statement: Gabapentinoids (e.g., gabapentin, pregabalin) for non-neuropathic pain (lack of evidence of efficacy).

source.document: O'Mahony D, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632, Appendix 1 (corrected supplementary file; NHS Somerset copy used for text, sentence-identical to the earlier parse)
source.citation: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y
source.credit: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y

plain_summary: Gabapentin and pregabalin have not been shown to help pain that does not come from the nerves.

medicine_groups.name: Gabapentinoids
medicine_groups.note: Capsules, tablets and liquids count. Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too.

needs_facts.what: Type of pain the gabapentinoid is used for
needs_facts.meets: The record links this gabapentinoid to treatment of non-neuropathic pain.

options.words: Used for pain that is not nerve pain
Nerve pain is the only pain treated
Used only for a reason other than pain

rule_for_models: Apply this criterion only to people aged 65 years or older. If age is unknown and the other conditions are met, report only a possible finding and ask for the age. Flag gabapentin or pregabalin when the record links that medicine to treatment of non-neuropathic pain. Cite the supply and the line giving the indication. If the indication or pain mechanism is unknown, report only a possible finding and identify what is missing. Use solely for epilepsy, neuropathic pain or another indication gives no L5 finding. A separate diagnosis does not change the recorded indication.
cannot_be_seen: The reason the gabapentinoid was prescribed, because both medicines are also used for epilepsy and anxiety, and whether the person has both nerve pain and other pain.
ask_the_gp: A review of what the gabapentinoid is being used for and whether it is still helping.
